rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a 3AA expanded blastocyst, including expanded cavity, thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE. Minor limitation is some image-specific detail is inferred from the provided grade rather than clearly verifiable from the text alone.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, male factor, endometrial thickness, and prior cycle history with embryo quality well. Some factors are slightly overstated or less directly linked to embryo competence.
Overall logic is structured, but there are inconsistencies: it cites 60-70% euploidy early, then later says 40-50% euploidy for this age group, and some probability adjustments appear ad hoc.

SET recommendation and general embryo assessment align with standard IVF practice, but ERA and microbiome testing are not routine guideline-based recommendations after this history, and alcohol/stress effect sizes are overstated.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, monitoring, and possible future workup. Some suggestions are practical, though a few are more speculative than standard-of-care.
